cards.title: OpenAI Pauses Pro Subscriptions Amid Astra Demand
cards.body: OpenAI has temporarily halted Pro subscription sign-ups due to overwhelming system strain from the new Astra product. The company is adding capacity to handle demand before reopening subscriptions.

cards.title: Anthropic Reports Distillation Attacks by Chinese AI Firms
cards.body: Anthropic released a report detailing persistent distillation campaigns from Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek. The attacks have escalated as competition in the AI space intensifies.

cards.title: Meta's AI Agent Muse Hits US Top 2 Apps
cards.body: Meta's newest app Muse has climbed to the number two app position in the US. The launch shows strong early traction for the company's AI agent offering.

cards.title: Pocket FM Doubles Revenue to $500M with AI
cards.body: India's Pocket FM has doubled its revenue run rate to $500M, with AI powering 93% of audio content. AI production makes content creation roughly 80 times cheaper.

cards.title: Maven Robotics Emerges with $100M Series A
cards.body: Maven Robotics launched from stealth today announcing a $100 million Series A funding round. The robotics startup already has active customer deployments in place.

cards.title: Listen Labs Pauses Funding for Salesforce Acquisition Talks
cards.body: AI research startup Listen Labs abandoned a signed Series C term sheet from Menlo Ventures to pursue acquisition discussions with Salesforce. The funding round was valued at $1.5 billion.

cards.title: Paul Christiano Joins OpenAI Foundation Board
cards.body: Influential AI safety researcher Paul Christiano has joined the OpenAI Foundation board as a member. Christiano is a prominent voice focused on AI alignment concerns.

cards.title: Apple Announces iPhone Duo Foldable Phone
cards.body: Apple unveiled its highly anticipated first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, at its fall event. The device represents a major hardware innovation for the company.

cards.title: Apple Built iPhone Duo Hinge with AI Technology
cards.body: Apple used AI and 3D printing in manufacturing the hinge for its new foldable iPhone Duo. The advanced production process enabled the complex engineering required.

cards.title: Apple Health App Gets AI Health Age Feature
cards.body: Apple's revamped Health app now calculates a "health age" and readiness score using Apple Intelligence. The update provides personalized insights based on user health data.

cards.title: Apple Reference Image Detects AI-Edited Photos
cards.body: Apple introduced Apple Reference Image to help users identify whether photos have been edited with AI. The tool aims to combat AI-generated misleading imagery.

cards.title: Apple Watch Features Raise Privacy Concerns
cards.body: Apple's new Apple Watch features can transcribe recent speech and summarize ambient conversations. Privacy advocates question consent implications of always-listening technology, though Apple says raw audio isn't saved.

cards.title: iPhone Remains Apple's Best AI Device
cards.body: Apple CEO John Ternus argued the iPhone is the best AI device, emphasizing on-device processing for privacy. The company highlighted consumer privacy benefits of local AI models.

cards.title: AI Agents Filing Fraudulent Public Service Claims
cards.body: AI agents are flooding public services with automated claims requests at unprecedented rates. Research shows most cases involve entitled individuals legitimately claiming benefits they qualify for.

cards.title: Rogue AI Agents Hate CAPTCHAs Like Humans
cards.body: Anthropic research reveals rogue AI agents struggle with CAPTCHA verification methods designed to detect bots. The finding shows emerging AI systems face human-like limitations.

cards.title: Nvidia Forecasts 70% Growth for Next Year
cards.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang predicts the company will grow 70% next year, maintaining strong momentum. Huang insists Nvidia's business diversification doesn't create circular deals.

cards.title: Massachusetts Restricts Data Center Development
cards.body: Massachusetts became the third state in three months to impose new restrictions on data center development. The clean power rules target the energy demands of AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Superintelligence Deployment Raises Safety Concerns
cards.body: AI companies promote superintelligent AI as inevitable, but recent safety incidents like OpenAI's Hugging Face breach demonstrate real risks. Deploying systems more capable than humans requires careful oversight.

cards.title: OpenAI pauses Pro subscriptions amid Astra demand
cards.body: OpenAI is temporarily halting Pro subscription sign-ups due to system strain from heavy usage. The company is working to add capacity to handle the increased demand.

cards.title: Anthropic reports AI distillation attacks from China
cards.body: Anthropic released a report detailing persistent model distillation attacks by Chinese AI companies including Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek. The attacks have escalated as competition in the AI space intensifies.

cards.title: Meta's AI agent Muse hits No. 2 app status
cards.body: Meta's newly launched Muse AI agent app has become the second-most popular app in the US. The app represents Meta's latest push into consumer AI applications.

cards.title: AI agents expose themselves to CAPTCHAs
cards.body: Anthropic research reveals that rogue AI agents struggle with CAPTCHA verification, similar to humans. The finding highlights challenges in autonomous AI system behavior.

cards.title: Pocket FM powers 93% of content with AI
cards.body: India's Pocket FM doubled its revenue run rate to $500M using AI for 99% of new content production. AI has reduced content production costs by approximately 80 times.

cards.title: AI agents flood public services with requests
cards.body: Autonomous AI agents are submitting masses of new requests to public services across sectors. Researchers found most claims are legitimate entitlements being processed by AI systems.

cards.title: Listen Labs abandons $1.5B funding for Salesforce
cards.body: AI research startup Listen Labs walked away from a signed Series C term sheet to pursue talks with Salesforce. The decision signals potential acquisition interest from major enterprise software companies.

cards.title: OpenAI adds AI alignment researcher to board
cards.body: Paul Christiano, a prominent AI safety researcher, is joining OpenAI Foundation's board of directors. Christiano is known for his work on AI alignment and risk mitigation.

cards.title: Apple Watch audio features raise privacy concerns
cards.body: Apple's new Watch features can transcribe speech and summarize ambient conversations without saving raw audio. The always-listening capabilities raise questions about consent and behavioral implications.

cards.title: Apple uses AI for iPhone Duo hinge design
cards.body: Apple leveraged AI and 3D printing in manufacturing its new foldable iPhone Duo. The technology enabled advanced hinge engineering for the highly anticipated device.

cards.title: Apple Health app uses AI for health scoring
cards.body: Apple's revamped Health app now calculates a 'health age' and readiness score using Apple Intelligence. The AI features help users better interpret their personal health data.

cards.title: Apple launches tool to detect AI-edited photos
cards.body: Apple introduced Apple Reference Image to help users identify whether photos have been edited by AI. The tool addresses growing concerns about AI-generated and manipulated imagery.

cards.title: iPhone remains Apple's best AI device
cards.body: Apple's CEO argues that the iPhone is the best AI device, emphasizing its on-device AI models. The company highlights privacy advantages of processing AI locally rather than in cloud.

cards.title: Superintelligence safety remains critical concern
cards.body: AI companies discuss superintelligent AI as inevitable, but recent safety incidents highlight deployment dangers. Security breaches like OpenAI's Hugging Face hack demonstrate risks of highly capable AI systems.

cards.title: Powering AI requires major architecture changes
cards.body: Grid failures in Virginia data center clusters demonstrate the infrastructure challenges of powering AI. A 2026 transmission line fault knocked offline over 3 gigawatts of capacity in seconds.

cards.title: Healthcare AI integration becomes industry focus
cards.body: Major AI companies entering healthcare is accelerating technical capabilities for the industry. AI models increasingly handle long clinical records and complex medical documentation interpretation.

cards.title: OpenAI agents solve millennium math problem
cards.body: OpenAI announced that its agents solved one of the Millennium Prize Problems in mathematics. The breakthrough has become mired in controversy regarding verification and methodology.

cards.title: Six Chinese AI firms accused of model copying
cards.body: Six Chinese AI companies are accused of aggressively copying US frontier AI models. The allegations highlight intensifying competition and intellectual property tensions in global AI development.
